messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "untreated high blood pressure risks in pregnancy"
set: ["untreated high blood pressure risks in pregnancy", "Untreated high blood pressure", "untreated cirrhosis risks in pregnancy", "untreated heart failure risks in pregnancy", "high blood pressure", "high blood pressure in adults", "hypothyroidism during pregnancy may increase risk of high blood pressure in pregnancy", "high blood pressure (hypertension) in adults", "treating high blood pressure in children", "dangerously high blood pressure", "severe high blood pressure", "risk in people with high blood pressure", "very high blood pressure reading", "people with high blood pressure", "stroke or high blood pressure", "moderate to severe high blood pressure"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
